NYRR Staten Island Half - Volunteers

  • 9+1 Credit
Add to calendar (opens in a new tab)

October 11, 2026, Sunday at 5:00 AM, Staten Island - Staten Island - St George Terminal

All Tags
Registration Option Sold Out

Fluid Station

Staten Island - St George Terminal |5:30 AM

Report Location: Staten Island - St. George Terminal, 5:30AM – 12:30PM. Volunteers help keep race participants hydrated with water and Gatorade on the course.

  • 9+1
Registration Option Sold Out

Start and Finish

Staten Island - St George Terminal |6:15 AM

Report Location: Staten Island - St. George Terminal 6:15 AM – 12:30 PM Volunteers will assist at the start and finish of the race. At the start, they will assist with loading the corrals, ensuring all runners go into the appropriate corral.

  • 9+1

Post-Race Amenities

Staten Island - St George Terminal |6:45 AM

Report Location: Staten Island - St. George Terminal 6:45AM – 12:30PM Volunteers will assist with the set up and break down of the amenities area in the finish walk off.

  • 9+1
Registration Option Sold Out

Medals Distribution

Staten Island - St George Terminal |6:30 AM

Report Location: Staten Island - St George Terminal, 6:30AM – 12:30AM. Volunteers will assist in the set-up, operation, and break down of the medals distribution area of the runner walk-off area.

  • 9+1

Staten Island - St George Terminal |6:00 AM

Entry fees: free

Report Location: Staten Island - St George Terminal, 6:30AM – 12AM. Our weekly medical volunteers help out at our finish line medical tent, alongside staff, to ensure a safe event.

Bag Check
